examples.question: Find the top 5 movies with the most votes.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.votes IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.votes ORDER BY m.votes DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: List all movies with a 'Pretty funny at times' review summary.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(p:Person) WHERE r.summary = 'Pretty funny at times' RETURN m.title

examples.question: List the movies with more than 100 votes.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.votes > 100 RETURN m.title

examples.question: Who are the top 3 producers by the number of movies with different taglines?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline IS NOT NULL WITH p, count(DISTINCT m.tagline) AS distinctTaglines ORDER BY distinctTaglines DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.name, distinctTaglines

examples.question: Which people have directed movies with a budget higher than $100 million?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m

examples.question: What are the roles of Keanu Reeves in 'The Matrix'?

examples.question: List all people who have written and directed the same movie.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:WROTE]->(m:Movie) WHERE (p)-[:DIRECTED]->(m) RETURN DISTINCT p.name

examples.question: Which top 5 people have directed movies with more than 200 votes?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.votes > 200 WITH p, count(m) AS num_movies ORDER BY num_movies DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN p.name AS director, num_movies

examples.question: List the names of people who acted in movies directed by Nancy Meyers.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Nancy Meyers'})-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) MATCH (a:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m) RETURN DISTINCT a.name

examples.question: What are the top 3 highest rated reviews and which movies they are associated with?

examples.question: Which movies have been both written and directed by the same person and what are their titles?

examples.question: List the movies with exactly 3 roles in the ACTED_IN relationship.

examples.question: What are the first 3 movies with a released year of 2008?

examples.question: What is the average number of words in the review summaries of movies with a rating above 95?

examples.question: Which people follow Keanu Reeves and have also acted in a movie with him?

examples.question: Who are the first three people who have directed and reviewed the same movie?

examples.question: Find all movies with a rating above 90.

examples.question: What is the longest movie title in the database?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, size(m.title) AS length ORDER BY length DESC LIMIT 1

examples.question: Which person directed the movie "V for Vendetta"?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: "V for Vendetta"})<-[:DIRECTED]-(p:Person) RETURN p.name

examples.question: List the top 3 directors who have directed movies with the highest average votes.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WITH m, avg(m.votes) AS average_votes MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m) WITH p, average_votes ORDER BY average_votes DESC RETURN p.name AS director_name, avg(average_votes) AS average_movie_votes LIMIT 3

examples.question: What are the first 3 movies with a vote count less than 100?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.votes < 100 RETURN m.title ORDER BY m.votes LIMIT 3

examples.question: Find the first 3 people who acted in a movie released in the 1990s.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.released >= 1990 AND m.released < 2000 RETURN p.name LIMIT 3

examples.question: Who are the first 3 people to have produced a movie with more than 500 votes?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.votes > 500 RETURN p.name LIMIT 3

examples.question: List the top 5 movies by the number of roles and their respective actors.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[ai:ACTED_IN]-(p:Person) RETURN m.title AS movie, collect(p.name) AS actors, size(ai.roles) AS numRoles ORDER BY numRoles DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: Who are the first 3 people born in the 1960s that Keanu Reeves follows?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: "Keanu Reeves"})-[:FOLLOWS]->(followed:Person) WHERE followed.born >= 1960 AND followed.born < 1970 RETURN followed ORDER BY followed.born LIMIT 3

examples.question: Which movies have more than 3 actors listed?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(p:Person) WITH m, count(p) AS actorCount WHERE actorCount > 3 RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, actorCount

examples.question: Which person reviewed the movie with the lowest rating?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WITH p, r, m ORDER BY r.rating ASC LIMIT 1 RETURN p.name AS reviewer, m.title AS movie, r.rating AS rating

examples.question: List the first 3 people who acted in a movie released in 2012.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.released = 2012 RETURN p.name LIMIT 3

examples.question: Show the top 5 people who have the most followers.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)<-[:FOLLOWS]-(follower:Person) WITH p, COUNT(follower) AS followerCount ORDER BY followerCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN p.name AS personName, followerCount

examples.question: Show the first 3 people who have reviewed more than one movie.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WITH p, count(m) AS movies_reviewed WHERE movies_reviewed > 1 RETURN p LIMIT 3

examples.question: How many movies released after 2000 have "coolest" in their review summary?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(p:Person) WHERE r.summary CONTAINS 'coolest' AND m.released > 2000 RETURN count(m)

examples.question: What is the average rating of movies released in 2003?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {released: 2003})<-[r:REVIEWED]-() WITH avg(r.rating) AS averageRating RETURN averageRating

examples.question: List the roles of any person in movies with a title containing 'Matrix'.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.title CONTAINS 'Matrix' RETURN p.name AS person, m.title AS movie, r.roles AS roles

examples.question: What is the oldest movie that Keanu Reeves acted in?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: "Keanu Reeves"})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH min(m.released) AS oldestMovie MATCH (p:Person {name: "Keanu Reeves"})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.released = oldestMovie RETURN m.title, m.released

examples.question: What are the 3 oldest persons in the database?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name, p.born ORDER BY p.born ASC LIMIT 3

examples.question: Name 3 movies with taglines that contain the word 'Speed'.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline CONTAINS 'Speed' RETURN m.title LIMIT 3

examples.question: What are the top 3 oldest movies in the database by release year?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, m.released ORDER BY m.released ASC LIMIT 3

examples.question: What are the top 5 highest rated movies based on votes?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, m.votes ORDER BY m.votes DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: List the top 5 movies with a tagline containing 'football'.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline CONTAINS 'football' RETURN m ORDER BY m.released DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: What are the common roles for Keanu Reeves across all his movies?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Keanu Reeves'})-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH p, collect(r.roles) AS rolesList UNWIND rolesList AS roles UNWIND roles AS role RETURN p.name, role, count(*) AS times_played ORDER BY times_played DESC

examples.question: Find movies with the tagline 'Welcome to the Real World'.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {tagline: 'Welcome to the Real World'}) RETURN m.title

examples.question: List the movies that have been both directed and produced by the same person.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)<-[:PRODUCED]-(p) RETURN m.title AS movie

examples.question: Who has the highest average review rating?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WITH p, avg(r.rating) AS avg_rating RETURN p.name, avg_rating ORDER BY avg_rating DESC LIMIT 1

examples.question: List three movies reviewed with a rating above 90.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(p:Person) WHERE r.rating > 90 RETURN m.title LIMIT 3

examples.question: List the roles played by actors in the first 3 movies directed by Nancy Meyers.
examples.cypher: MATCH (director:Person {name: "Nancy Meyers"})-[:DIRECTED]->(movie:Movie) WITH movie ORDER BY movie.released LIMIT 3 MATCH (actor:Person)-[actedIn:ACTED_IN]->(movie) RETURN movie.title AS MovieTitle, actor.name AS ActorName, actedIn.roles AS Roles

examples.question: Who are the top 3 producers of movies with a tagline including 'Speed'?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline CONTAINS 'Speed' RETURN p.name AS producer, COUNT(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: What is the average rating difference between movies directed by the same person?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m1:Movie) MATCH (p)-[:DIRECTED]->(m2:Movie) WHERE id(m1) < id(m2) WITH m1, m2, abs(avg(m1.rating) - avg(m2.rating)) AS rating_diff RETURN avg(rating_diff) AS average_rating_difference

examples.question: Who are the top 3 actors in terms of movies acted in from 1990 to 2000?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.released >= 1990 AND m.released <= 2000 WITH p, count(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.name AS actor, movieCount

examples.question: Who reviewed the most movies?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) RETURN p.name, count(m) AS movies_reviewed ORDER BY movies_reviewed DESC LIMIT 1

examples.question: What are the top 5 movies with the least votes and their release years?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.votes IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.released, m.votes ORDER BY m.votes LIMIT 5

examples.question: Which 3 directors have directed the most movies released after 2005?
examples.cypher: MATCH (d:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.released > 2005 WITH d, count(m) AS num_movies ORDER BY num_movies DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN d.name AS director, num_movies

examples.question: Who are the top 3 actors by number of followers?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:FOLLOWS]->(actor:Person) WITH actor, count(p) AS followers ORDER BY followers DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN actor.name, followers

examples.question: Name 3 movies reviewed with a rating over 90.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.rating > 90 RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle LIMIT 3

examples.question: What is the average number of votes for movies released in the same year "Speed Racer" was released?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: 'Speed Racer'}) WITH m.released AS releaseYear MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released = releaseYear RETURN avg(m.votes) AS averageVotes

examples.question: Name the first 3 people born before 1950 who have written a movie with a tagline mentioning 'journey'.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:WROTE]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born < 1950 AND m.tagline CONTAINS 'journey' RETURN p.name LIMIT 3

examples.question: Name 3 directors who have directed movies with the least number of votes.
examples.cypher: MATCH (d:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH d, min(m.votes) AS minVotes ORDER BY minVotes LIMIT 3 RETURN d.name AS director

examples.question: List the actors born before 1960.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.born < 1960 RETURN p.name

examples.question: Who are the top 3 actors in terms of the diversity of roles played?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH p, size(apoc.coll.toSet(collect(r.roles))) AS roleDiversity RETURN p.name AS actor, roleDiversity ORDER BY roleDiversity DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: Which people have written and directed the same movie?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:WROTE]->(m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(p) RETURN DISTINCT p.name

examples.question: List all the movies with the summary "A solid romp".
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-() WHERE r.summary = "A solid romp" RETURN m.title

examples.question: Which people were born between 1940 and 1960?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.born >= 1940 AND p.born <= 1960 RETURN p.name, p.born

examples.question: What are the first 3 movies where Nancy Meyers was involved as a writer and their release years?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: "Nancy Meyers"})-[:WROTE]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, m.released AS ReleaseYear ORDER BY m.released LIMIT 3

examples.question: List the movies directed by persons born after 1960.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born > 1960 RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, p.name AS DirectorName

examples.question: What is the average rating given by people born after 1980?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born > 1980 RETURN avg(r.rating) AS average_rating

examples.question: Which 3 people born before 1950 acted in a movie with a tagline containing 'limits'?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born < 1950 AND m.tagline CONTAINS 'limits' RETURN p.name LIMIT 3

examples.question: Name the people who have produced movies with less than 100 votes.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.votes < 100 RETURN p.name

examples.question: Who are the first 3 actors by the number of different movies acted in?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH p, count(DISTINCT m) AS movies_count ORDER BY movies_count DESC RETURN p.name, movies_count LIMIT 3

examples.question: List the top 5 movies by number of roles in the 'ACTED_IN' relationship.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:ACTED_IN]-(p:Person) RETURN m.title AS movie, size(r.roles) AS numRoles ORDER BY numRoles DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: Find the movie with the highest number of votes that does not have the word "a" in its title.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE NOT m.title CONTAINS 'a' RETURN m ORDER BY m.votes DESC LIMIT 1

examples.question: Show the top 5 movies by the number of reviews they received.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:REVIEWED]-(r:Person) WITH m, count(r) AS reviewCount RETURN m.title AS movieTitle, reviewCount ORDER BY reviewCount DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: List the roles of Laurence Fishburne in movies with a release year after 2000.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: "Laurence Fishburne"})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.released > 2000 RETURN m.title, m.released, [(p)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m) | r.roles] AS roles

examples.question: What is the average number of votes for movies with a rating above 90?
examples.cypher: MATCH (:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.rating > 90 WITH avg(m.votes) AS average_votes RETURN average_votes

examples.question: Which person has directed movies with a rating higher than 95?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-() WHERE r.rating > 95 RETURN DISTINCT p.name

examples.question: What is the average number of followers for people born in the 1980s?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:FOLLOWS]->(f:Person) WHERE p.born >= 1980 AND p.born < 1990 WITH f, COUNT(p) AS followers RETURN AVG(followers) AS average_followers

examples.question: What is the average rating of movies with the word "funny" in their review summary and released after 2010?
examples.cypher: MATCH (:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.summary CONTAINS 'funny' AND m.released > 2010 WITH avg(r.rating) AS averageRating RETURN averageRating

examples.question: List the top 5 most recent movies in the graph.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m ORDER BY m.released DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: Which people have reviewed the same movie and what were their review summaries?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p1:Person)-[r1:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie)<-[r2:REVIEWED]-(p2:Person) WHERE p1 <> p2 RETURN p1.name AS Reviewer1, p2.name AS Reviewer2, m.title AS Movie, r1.summary AS Review1, r2.summary AS Review2

examples.question: What is the highest rating given to a movie?
examples.cypher: MATCH (:Person)-[review:REVIEWED]->(:Movie) WITH max(review.rating) AS highestRating RETURN highestRating

examples.question: What is the average number of votes for movies released in the 2000s?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released >= 2000 AND m.released < 2010 RETURN avg(m.votes) AS average_votes

examples.question: What are the combined total votes of all movies Joel Silver produced?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: "Joel Silver"})-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) RETURN sum(m.votes) AS total_votes

examples.question: Who are the directors of movies with more than 1000 votes?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:DIRECTED]-(p:Person) WHERE m.votes > 1000 RETURN p.name AS Director, m.title AS MovieTitle

examples.question: What are the top 5 reviewed movies by summary 'An amazing journey'?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(p:Person) WHERE r.summary = 'An amazing journey' RETURN m.title, count(r) AS reviews ORDER BY reviews DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: Who are the first three actors born after 1970 who acted in a movie released before 1990?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born > 1970 AND m.released < 1990 RETURN p.name AS actor_name, p.born AS birth_year, m.title AS movie_title, m.released AS release_year ORDER BY p.born LIMIT 3

examples.question: How many people born before 1950 have directed a movie?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born < 1950 RETURN count(DISTINCT p)

examples.question: What is the highest rating given to any movie by any person?
examples.cypher: MATCH (:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(:Movie) RETURN max(r.rating) AS highest_rating

examples.question: Which person has both acted in and directed the same movie?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(p) RETURN p.name AS person_name, m.title AS movie_title

examples.question: List the movies with the summary "A solid romp".
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-() WHERE r.summary = "A solid romp" RETURN m.title

examples.question: What is the average number of votes for movies released in the same year as "The Matrix Revolutions"?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: "The Matrix Revolutions"}) WITH m.released AS releaseYear MATCH (movies:Movie {released: releaseYear}) WITH avg(movies.votes) AS averageVotes RETURN averageVotes

examples.question: List the top 5 people who have produced the most number of movies with their birth years.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) RETURN p.name, p.born, count(m) AS movies_produced ORDER BY movies_produced DESC LIMIT 5
